title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into the Weak Encrypted Communication report. This can lead to another user executing attacker-controlled SPL commands with their permissions when interacting with the report's drilldown feature. The flaw arises from insufficient validation of certain report data before use in drilldown searches.
